description: Read one file of a pack, e.g. PRODUCT.md (the whole product), AGENTS.md (how to build it), BRIEF.md, obligations.toml, an assumption, or a component's symbolon.toml or examples.jsonl. "pack.md" is the whole pack as one Markdown page.

pack.description: The pack id, owner/name, e.g. kausalflow/lightkone. A symbola.sh pack link works too.

path.description: The file's path inside the pack, e.g. PRODUCT.md.

name: read_pack_file
title: Read a pack file
